Search /mnt/dados and /mnt/win1 for prior calculations or notes about "custo de contexto" (context cost), "janela de contexto" (context window) per local model, VRAM allocation for KV cache on the MI50 (16GB HBM2), or llama.cpp context benchmarks. 

Check:
1. /mnt/win1/123 tranqueiras e projetos/engenharia de harness.md (read it fully — it has the model matrix and VRAM allocation)
2. Any markdown notes in /mnt/dados with "contexto" or "KV cache" mentions
3. harness/metrics/ or harness/memory/ for any recorded context/token stats per model

Report: file paths, relevant excerpts with numbers (context windows per model, VRAM numbers, KV cache estimates, any formulas used previously), and dates if present. Be thorough.
